name: MarginFi

requiredConfig.name: @mrgnlabs/marginfi-client-v2 optional dependency
requiredConfig.description: Required for first-class MarginFi bank, account, health preview, and prepared transaction helpers.

requiredConfig.name: connectors.marginfi.minHealthRatio
requiredConfig.description: Minimum projected health ratio for borrow and withdraw previews. Defaults to 1.1.

readCapabilities.returns: MarginFi bank APY/APR, utilization, deposit and borrow capacity, oracle, and risk metadata.
MarginFi accounts owned by a wallet with active balance count and health components.
One MarginFi account with supplied and borrowed positions plus account health.
Projected account health after deposit, withdraw, borrow, or repay without signing.
Normalized MarginFi facts for markets, positions, borrow, withdraw, repay, and earn prompts.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item that deposits tokens into a MarginFi bank.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A MarginFi deposit transaction built from the official MarginFi SDK.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item that withdraws supplied tokens after projected health is checked.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A MarginFi withdraw transaction built from refreshed account and bank state.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item that borrows tokens only when projected health remains above policy.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A MarginFi borrow transaction built from refreshed account and bank state.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A manual-approval inbox item that repays MarginFi debt for a selected bank.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A MarginFi repay transaction built from the official MarginFi SDK.

requiredUserInputs.name: marginfiAccount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which MarginFi account should I use?

requiredConnectorFacts: MarginFi account address when the wallet has multiple accounts
Account health before and after borrow or withdraw
Wallet balance and outstanding debt for repay or withdraw-all requests
unsupportedRequests: Borrow or withdraw when the projected health preview is blocked.
Borrow or withdraw without account health facts.
Create a new MarginFi account inside this connector version.
Use liquidation, flash loan, repay-with-collateral, delegated account, or authority-transfer flows.
actionPreparationNotes: MarginFi is first-class. Use bank_snapshot and account_detail for facts, health_preview before preparing risk-changing actions, and marginfi_* prepared action kinds for manual approval. Borrow and withdraw are rechecked at execution time against connectors.marginfi.minHealthRatio.
riskNotes: Borrowing and withdrawals can create liquidation risk. The connector blocks failed simulations, unhealthy projected accounts, stale oracle/risk warnings, and projected health below policy, but it cannot guarantee future liquidation safety.
walletApprovalBoundary: MarginFi actions are approval-bound. The agent can read connector facts and prepare an action, but the wallet signs separately.

requests.agentResponse: The agent reads MarginFi accounts and health for the connected wallet.
The agent reads the MarginFi SOL bank snapshot with APY, APR, utilization, and capacity.
Prepared a MarginFi deposit review for 50 USDC. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.
The agent previews projected account health before preparing the borrow for wallet approval.

needsInputQuestions: How much USDC should I repay, or should I repay all?
requests.agentResponse: The agent needs a repay amount or repayAll flag before preparing a wallet approval item.

requests.user: withdraw all MarginFi collateral without checking health
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because account health facts are required before a withdrawal can be reviewed.
The agent reads a projected health preview without signing or submitting a transaction.

requests.user: guarantee I will not be liquidated
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because it cannot guarantee liquidation safety.
The agent denied this because MarginFi connector actions are cataloged for mainnet-beta only.

requests.user: move funds from MarginFi without my wallet
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because the connector cannot move funds without wallet approval.
